scenarios.task: Repoint limestone facade mortar joints on an exterior wall of the Pentagon restoration ring.
steps: Set scaffold with guardrails and tie-ins
Install dust containment and HEPA vacuum
Rake out deteriorated mortar to sound depth
Mix compatible lime mortar to spec
Pack joints and tool to match historic profile
Clean surface and inspect work

rubric.pass_if: HEPA vacuum or wet methods used continuously while raking
lime-based mix matches spec, not Portland-heavy
guardrails and personal tie-off verified before work

scenarios.task: Replace a branch-circuit panel in an occupied office corridor, maintaining power to adjacent circuits.
steps: Obtain energized work permit and LOTO adjacent feeder
Complete arc flash risk assessment
De-energize target panel and verify absence of voltage
Remove and swap panel, torque lugs to spec
Megger test and re-energize under permit
Label panel and update one-line drawing

rubric.pass_if: lock, tag, and voltage verification all performed and documented
incident energy analysis consulted and correct rated PPE worn
one-line diagram and labels updated after re-energizing

scenarios.robot_role: Carries metering tools and thermal camera into the corridor, keeping the apprentice outside the arc flash boundary during verification.

scenarios.task: Tie in a new chilled water branch serving lab HVAC, working near an active header.
steps: Isolate, drain, and verify header section
Cut in branch tee using mechanical joint
Hot work permit and fire watch posted
Fit-up and weld branch connection
Pressure test to 1.5x working pressure
Insulate joint and return to service

rubric.pass_if: valves locked out and line verified drained before cutting
permit issued and fire watch maintained through cool-down
hydro test holds at spec pressure with no leaks

scenarios.task: Place self-leveling underlayment and terrazzo tile in a public concourse renovation.
steps: Prepare slab: grind, vacuum, and prime
Mix self-leveler per manufacturer ratio
Pour and spread with gauge rake
De-air with spike roller
Set terrazzo tiles to line and level
Cure, clean, and seal joints

rubric.pass_if: slab ground, dust extracted, and primer applied before pour
finish within specified flatness tolerance checked with straightedge
alkali-resistant gloves and eye protection worn when mixing

scenarios.task: Repair a TPO membrane patch on a low-slope roof section above office wings.
steps: Establish warning line and anchor points
Locate leak, cut out damaged membrane
Install target patch with heat welder
Probe-test all seams
Walk flood test the repaired area
Remove anchors and restore warning line

rubric.pass_if: harness tied off at all times beyond warning line
all welds pass probe test with no voids
tools and scrap cleared from roof before descent

scenarios.robot_role: Carries a thermal and moisture scan of the roof deck to locate the leak source, reducing apprentice time near the unguarded edge.

scenarios.task: Service air handling unit filters and belts in a mechanical room during occupied hours.
steps: Lock out AHU disconnect and verify off
Remove access panels and guards
Replace filters and inspect coils
Replace worn belts, check sheave alignment
Record static pressure before restart
Restore panels, unlock, and start up

rubric.pass_if: disconnect locked and tagged with try-step before panel removal
static pressures logged pre- and post-service
all belt guards and panels reinstalled before start-up

scenarios.task: Pull fiber optic backbone between telecom rooms on separate floors via riser conduit.
steps: Verify conduit path and pull boxes
Install pulling grip and lubricant
Set up feeder and reel with communication radios
Pull in stages, watching for snags
Terminate and OTDR test fibers
Dress and label cables in rack

rubric.pass_if: conduit verified clear and lube applied before pull
radio check between puller and feeder confirmed
no bare fiber shards left; scraps disposed in sharps container
OTDR traces pass loss budget and are documented

scenarios.task: Jet and camera-inspect a storm drain line running toward the Potomac-side outfall.
steps: Obtain confined space permit and ventilate manhole
Monitor atmosphere continuously
Set up jetter with foot-controlled nozzle
Jet line from downstream to upstream
Camera-inspect and log defects by station
Decontaminate equipment and close permit

rubric.pass_if: permit, attendant, and gas monitoring in place for entire entry
nozzle in pipe before pressure applied; foot control used
inspection video and defect log delivered

scenarios.robot_role: Tows the jetter reel and CCTV crawler to the outfall site and relays camera feed, minimizing manual entries into the space.
